faq.subtitle: What gets read, what gets checked, and when a human reviews it.
faq.a1: aiDOCS is aiNOW's document processing product. It extracts the fields you need from receipts, contracts, reports, or tables and turns them into a usable format.
faq.a2: aiDOCS works with PDFs, scans, photos, and email attachments. Low-quality files are marked for review.
faq.a3: aiDOCS shows low-confidence fields separately. A human reviews amounts, dates, ID numbers, signatures, and other sensitive data.
faq.q4: Where does the extracted data go?
faq.a4: The result can go to Excel, Google Sheets, a CRM, 1C, or another system if safe import is possible.
faq.q5: What result does the business get?
faq.a5: The business gets a searchable archive, consistent fields, and less manual data entry.
faq.q6: Does aiDOCS work with accounting software?
faq.a6: aiNOW prepares the agreed import format after checking the target system.
faq.q7: Does the accounting software need to change?
faq.a7: aiNOW first checks the current workflow and builds around the agreed format.
faq.a8: aiNOW defines scope and pricing after the document sample and volume are clear.
faq.a9: aiNOW documents the storage and access setup before processing starts.
faq.q10: Can a phone photo be used?
faq.a10: A phone photo can be included in the sample check.
faq.q11: What happens when a layout changes?
faq.a11: aiNOW checks the changed layout and updates the field mapping when required.
faq.a12: aiNOW compares the agreed sample flow with the current manual steps.
faq.a13: Customs files can be included in the sample check.
faq.a14: The accountant reviews and approves the final row.

scans.heading: A poor photo does not slip into the accounting row.

scans.okAction: The visible fields can move to the draft.
scans.heldAction: The highlighted value waits for a person.
scans.failAction: Nothing is added until a clearer source is supplied.

accuracy.heading: The team chooses what must be reviewed.
accuracy.subtitle: A higher line holds more fields for a person. A lower line lets more fields move automatically.
accuracy.green: The known demo errors are held for review.
accuracy.neutral: All fields are held for review.
accuracy.red: A known demo error crosses the line.
accuracy.claim: aiNOW shows the effect of the selected line.
accuracy.honest: These values belong only to this sample document.
accuracy.caught: This value stays out of the draft.
accuracy.w11: The demo date differs from the source date.
accuracy.w12: The demo purpose is not present in the source.
accuracy.autoReady: This value can move to the draft.
accuracy.reviewReady: This value waits for a person.
accuracy.businessResult: aiNOW keeps uncertain values visible while the team chooses a safe review line.

capabilities.title: From document to checked accounting data
capabilities.intro: aiDOCS handles routine document work and sends anything uncertain to a person.

1.title: Document to accounting row
1.description: Reads the date, supplier, VAT, and total from an invoice or receipt.
1.result: The accountant receives a prepared row instead of retyping the page.

2.title: Automatic document sorting
2.description: Groups invoices, receipts, contracts, and other files by type.
2.result: Each document reaches the right work queue.

3.title: Scans and photos
3.description: Reads PDFs, scans, and phone photos without guessing unclear handwriting.
3.result: Clear data moves forward and unclear parts are marked for review.

4.title: Uncertain value control
4.description: Stops a field when the source is unclear or values do not match.
4.result: A doubtful number cannot quietly enter the accounting system.

5.title: Accountant approval
5.description: Prepares the draft and keeps final approval with the responsible person.
5.result: Routine work is faster while the business keeps control.
